newsitem.title: UK: IPE futures recover as Brent fails to break $22.
newsitem.headline: IPE futures recover as Brent fails to break $22.

text.p: IPE Brent crude and gas oil futures rallied in late afternoon trade after Brent bounced off technical support.
March Brent at 1725 GMT was trading up two cents at $22.28 a barrel after failing to break support at $22.
Brent last went below $22 on September 23.
"We had a reasonable attempt at breaking support but failed and now it's just taking a breather," said a broker. "But I wouldn't rule out another go later on," he added.
"It is just holding its own and does not look as if it is reviving. I would not be surprised to see it dip below $22," said Tony Machuchak at Credit Lyonannais Rouse.
Gas oil had recovered most of its losses to close down 25 cents at tonne at $199.75 from its low of $195.50 "We saw some spread buying toward the close," said a broker.
Dealers said U.S. heating oil was helping underpin the IPE recovery.
February heating oil on NYMEX recoverd from a 0.60 cent decline to stand 0.70 cent up.
